summary: Iteration 2 testing of 4 new features (cell rotation, texts on passe-partout, auto-arrange, premium frames + finder + glass) plus regression of export dimensions. Backend: 18/18 pytest passed (12 existing regression + 6 new for rotation & texts). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: all 4 new features verified in the UI. Auto-arrange picked 6-grid for 6 sample photos and filled every cell. Cell rotation applied via rotate-right-90 (CSS transform contains 'rotate') and reset works. Texts: add-title-button places 'Il nostro titolo' at the bottom of the passe-partout, add-free-text-button + text-content-input update live, font switch (dancing), color swatch, and delete-text-button all work. add-caption-button adds a 'Didascalia' under the selected cell. Cornici Premium: glass-toggle enables anti-glare overlay (detected in DOM), frame-color-wood/metal switch colors. Trova cornici: dialog opens with all 6 shop links (Amazon.it, IKEA, ifolor, Leroy Merlin, Etsy, Google Shopping) - 5 of 6 URLs contain the 50x70 size (ifolor deep-links to its dedicated collage-frames landing page by design). Save project works (toast 'Progetto salvato' shown).

issues: Radix warning: DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description. Non-blocking a11y warning.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to FrameFinder Dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py draw_texts: font is loaded (ImageFont.truetype) once per text on every export - fine but could be cached by (font, size) pair for very-many-text exports.
put_object / get_object / build_collage still called via sync requests inside async handlers on /api/export - not blocking for typical single-user use but noted from iter1.
FrameFinder: ifolor URL is not parameterized by size; acceptable per spec (deep-link to its collage-frame landing page) but consider constructing a search URL for consistency.
seed_data_creation: 6 sample photos reused from prior import-samples (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py (regression) + test_new_features.py (rotation + texts + full CollageSpec across jpg/pdf/png) both green. UI covered: auto-arrange, cell rotation + reset, add title/free text/caption, text edit (content/font/color/delete), glass toggle overlay, frame color wood/metal, find-frames dialog with 6 shops, save project. Export UI download and reopen-project restore-with-rotation were not exercised in this iteration but export API is verified with rotation and texts.
